description:
Two uncommitted changes were sitting on main (workflow breach):

1. docs/PRINCIPLES.md — 'Disk first' rewrite: replaces 'context, config, history, in-flight work, agent notes' with 'context, messages while in flight, responses, tool calls' in the state list.
2. CLAUDE.md — new symlink -> AGENTS.md so Claude reads the repo-scoped AGENTS.md.

Both were reverted/unstaged on main. This task re-applies them through the correct worktree flow. Content preserved exactly as the user had it; this task is about workflow hygiene, not redesign.

Patch for (1) saved at /tmp/principles-diskfirst.patch.
title: Salvage stray main-branch state into proper worktree flow
